visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation/Graphic Background in bright orange with yellow energy flashes. Then it cuts to three men sitting on a grey couch. The man on the left wears a blue hoodie, the middle man has long curly hair and a black shirt over a brown top, and the man on the right wears a blue jacket. A hand holds a tall paper cup in the foreground. (2) The middle man takes the cup, holds it up, and the man on the right leans in to smell it. They all have expressions of amusement and slight disgust. (3) A top-down close-up of a white paper cup containing thick beige milk foam topped with a small pile of chopped green herbs. (4) Close-up of a hand pouring a dark brown, oily liquid from a small ceramic pitcher into the beige milk foam, creating a marbled effect. (5) The three men are seen from a medium shot, each holding a cup and drinking simultaneously. The middle man pulls away, licking his lips with a confused and slightly repulsed expression. (6) A hand pours more beige milk foam with green herbs into a larger pink paper cup containing a dark reddish-brown liquid. (7) The middle man looks shocked, eyes wide, as he uses chopsticks to pull long, wavy noodles out of the paper cup. All three men now have chopsticks and are lifting noodles from their respective cups. (8) Close-up of the man on the left eating noodles with a pained facial expression. The middle man laughs and playfully hits the man on the right with a grey pillow. (9) The middle man smiles warmly and rests his head on the shoulder of the man on the right. Pink heart graphics and a soft pink filter are overlaid on the screen. (10) The men sit back on the couch, talking and laughing. The man on the right gives a thumbs-up while looking slightly nauseous. The scene remains in the brightly lit indoor room with white walls.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo electronic synthesizer BGM starts. A male voice introduces a drink with a clear, projecting tone. (2) Sudden transition sound effect as the group laughs loudly. Overlapping chatter about the smell. (3) Soft splashing sound of liquid pouring. A man's voice, inquisitive and slightly disgusted, asks about the ingredients. (4) Slurping sounds followed by an exclamation about the taste resembling seasoning. Music continues with a steady beat. (5) High-pitched, shocked exclamation "There's noodles!" as the music swells. Rapid vocal delivery and excited tone. (6) Sounds of chewing and slurping. A rhythmic percussive thud as an object hits a surface. (7) Dramatic shift to soft, romantic piano and synth pad music. Voices become softer and more playful. (8) Return to upbeat electronic music. Loud laughter and a closing comment about the drink's bad taste delivered with a sarcastic, humorous tone. Overall high audio energy with constant speech-music overlap.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Ingredient reveal -> Tasting reaction -> Narrative shift/climax -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous food review and social experiment where three creators try a bizarre combination: 'Beef Noodle Milk Foam Tea'. The intent is to entertain through the cast's visceral and comedic reactions to the unexpected and seemingly unpleasant flavor combination of savory soup elements in a sweet drink.
